about: The feature catalog (raporlar/OZELLIK-PAKETLEME-PLANI-2026-10-29.md, redesigned 2026-10-31). A feature is a flag; a plan is a set of flags. kind: module (sold on its own), addon (sold on top of the base), program (granted by Touchque staff, never in a customer's picker) or base (always on, never sold apart). group: the picker heading it sits under (groups). side: which half of a company it runs in (workspace = the authenticator integration, organization = the SSO organization, both). includes: the lines the pickers show under it. dependsOn: turned on with it, turned off before it. limits and priceRef are the hooks prices attach to later. base: what every account has, for the pickers' Always included card; every route not bound to a feature belongs to it.
